category: hosted user authentication and user management (sign-up, sign-in, sessions, organizations)

free_tier.stated: Hobby: free with no credit card; 50,000 monthly retained users per app, unlimited applications, up to 3 dashboard seats
free_tier.notes: A user counts as retained only after signing in again more than 24 hours after sign-up. Above 50,000 retained users on Hobby a one-month grace period applies before an upgrade is needed. Hobby also includes 1,000 API key creations and 100,000 verifications, 2,500 M2M token creations and 100,000 verifications a month, 100 monthly retained organizations per app with up to 20 members each, and 10,000 protection checks a month. SMS codes and multi-factor authentication are not on Hobby. A development instance is capped at 100 users and delivers at most 20 SMS messages and 100 emails a month.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no size limit for user metadata is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: Application Logs are kept 1 day on Hobby (7 days on Pro, 30 days on Business)
retention.notes: No retention period for user records is stated on the pages read.

egress.terms: not applicable: an authentication API; no traffic allowance or egress term is published

interface_detail: Frontend API for sign-in and sign-up from the browser, rate limited per IP address; Backend API for administrative tasks, called with a secret key at https://api.clerk.com/v1 (a GET /v1/users without a key answered 401); webhooks for data sync.
tooling: Clerk SDKs and prebuilt sign-in components, the clerk CLI (npx clerk@latest), or any HTTP client against the Backend API with a secret key.
chaining: Login and user store for a web app on free hosting; leaving the 100-user development instance needs a domain with DNS records, which pairs with a cheap or free name from domains-dns.

limits.value: a production instance needs a domain the user owns and DNS records on it; a development instance is capped at 100 users
Backend API: 100 requests per 10 seconds on a development instance, 1000 requests per 10 seconds on a production instance
Frontend API sign-up creation: 5 requests per 10 seconds, limited per IP address
development instance: 20 SMS messages and 100 emails per calendar month

limits_note: Dashboard seats are capped at 3 on Hobby; the vocabulary has no kind for a seat count.
binding_note: Without a domain the app stays on a development instance, capped at 100 users and 100 emails a month; with a domain, the 50,000 retained users per app is the ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for an email address and a password, or a GitHub or Google sign-in, and states no credit card is required. A production instance also needs a domain with DNS records.

reliability_note: A rate-limited request answers 429 with a Retry-After header; Hobby email support covers billing, registration and abuse queries only.
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from first-party pricing, docs and sign-up pages; the Backend API host was probed and answered 401 without a key. A sign-in and a Backend API call on a Hobby instance would move it to measured.
